## Workflow


```{dot}
//| fig-width: 8
//| fig-height: 12
digraph {
  rankdir=TB
  node [fontname="Arial", shape=box, style="filled,rounded", margin="0.3,0.15", width=0]
  edge [fontname="Arial", fontsize=10]

  subgraph cluster_AT {
    label="Análisis temporal"
    style=filled; fillcolor="#f9f9f9"; color="#cccccc"

    A0 [label="Imagen Landsat",                                    fillcolor="#FBEAF0", color="#993556", fontcolor="#72243E"]
    A  [label="Índices espectrales y\nbandas ópticas",             fillcolor="#FBEAF0", color="#993556", fontcolor="#72243E"]
    B0 [label="MapBiomas assets",                                  fillcolor="#FBEAF0", color="#993556", fontcolor="#72243E"]
    B1 [label="Land cover\n(remap de año previo)",                 fillcolor="#FBEAF0", color="#993556", fontcolor="#72243E"]
    B2 [label="Mosaico anual\n(subset de año previo)",             fillcolor="#FBEAF0", color="#993556", fontcolor="#72243E"]
    B3 [label="Regiones", fillcolor="#FBEAF0", color="#993556", fontcolor="#72243E"]
    
    CL1 [label="Clasificador probabilístico\n(regresión logística)",fillcolor="white",  color="#993556", fontcolor="#72243E", style="filled"]
    C  [label="Probabilidad de quema\na nivel de observación",     fillcolor="#FBEAF0", color="#993556", fontcolor="#72243E"]
    D  [label="Métricas de resumen a nivel anual\n(prob max, diff max)", fillcolor="#FBEAF0", color="#993556", fontcolor="#72243E"]
    CL2 [label="Umbrales",                                         fillcolor="white",  color="#993556", fontcolor="#72243E", style="filled"]
    E1 [label="Semillas\n(celdas claramente quemadas)",            fillcolor="#FBEAF0", color="#993556", fontcolor="#72243E"]
    E2 [label="Candidatos\n(celdas plausiblemente quemadas)",      fillcolor="#FBEAF0", color="#993556", fontcolor="#72243E"]

    {rank=same; A0; B0}
    A0 -> B0 [style=invis]
    {rank=same; A; B1; B2; B3}
    A -> B1 [style=invis]
    B1 -> B2 [style=invis]
    B2 -> B3 [style=invis]

    A0 -> A
    B0 -> B1; B0 -> B2
    A -> CL1; B1 -> CL1; B2 -> CL1
    CL1 -> C
    C -> D [label="sub-anual → anual"]
    D -> CL2
    CL2 -> E1; CL2 -> E2
  }

  subgraph cluster_AE {
    label="Análisis espacial"
    style=filled; fillcolor="#f9f9f9"; color="#cccccc"

    F [label="Crecimiento de región\nde semillas a candidatos", fillcolor="#EEEDFE", color="#534AB7", fontcolor="#3C3489"]
    G [label="Grupos de píxeles\n(áreas quemadas)",             fillcolor="#EEEDFE", color="#534AB7", fontcolor="#3C3089"]
    H [label="Polígonos de área quemada",                       fillcolor="#EEEDFE", color="#534AB7", fontcolor="#3C3489"]
  }

  subgraph cluster_PR {
    label="Productos"
    style=filled; fillcolor="#f9f9f9"; color="#cccccc"

    I [label="Mes de quema / Tamaño de la cicatriz",          fillcolor="#E1F5EE", color="#0F6E56", fontcolor="#085041"]
    J [label="Año del último incendio / Frecuencia de fuego", fillcolor="#E1F5EE", color="#0F6E56", fontcolor="#085041"]
  }

  E1 -> F; E2 -> F
  F -> G; G -> H; H -> I; I -> J
}
